statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of four public templates/journeys. Not covered: authenticated editing, account creation, donation/payment completion, media playback, and every language/template variant because they require credentials, external transactions, or duplicate the selected archetypes.

page.notes: Server-rendered Japanese encyclopedia. Public reading, search and sign-in were sampled; source code was not provided.

paths.description: Entry page and dense portal template; tested as the primary orientation and browse surface.
Representative long-form encyclopedia article with infobox, table of contents, media, citations and thousands of links.
Primary search journey, using a query for ウェブ; it resolved predictably to the World Wide Web article.
Representative account form for labels, autocomplete, authentication affordances and humane interaction.

findings.summary: The default experience does not follow the operating-system dark preference.
findings.evidence: The screenshot captured with prefers-color-scheme: dark remains a white, light-themed page, despite the stylesheet containing prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the OS theme option the effective default, declare color-scheme: light dark, and ensure all Vector and content surfaces use preference-aware color tokens.

findings.summary: Cross-document article and search navigation swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: The article probe found no view-transition CSS signal, while article navigation is a core cross-document interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared page chrome, with reduced-motion behavior preserved.

findings.summary: Mobile pages use a fixed 1120 CSS-pixel layout and are scaled down instead of reflowing.
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 emulated viewport, layout reported clientWidth and scrollWidth of 1120 and the DOM probe found meta viewport content="width=1120"; screenshots show tiny desktop columns.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and responsive intrinsic layouts so article, infobox and portal columns reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Reusable portal and article components do not adapt independently to their available width.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container rules, and the 360px screenshots show the desktop composition uniformly scaled rather than cards and infoboxes recomposing.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reused content regions containment and add size-aware container-query layouts, retaining media-query fallbacks where needed.

findings.summary: Many article controls and links are too small for reliable touch input.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size on the article; the probe measured theme radios at 20x20px and repeated visible controls at 22x22px.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas and spacing to at least the WCAG target-size baseline without reducing information density for pointer users.

findings.summary: The representative long article misses a good loading-performance bar.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured article LCP at 6.0s, FCP at 3.9s and performance score 0.64; the lighter home trace measured LCP 1.05s, showing the article template is the high-risk path.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the article LCP breakdown, prioritize its LCP resource, shorten dependency chains and defer non-critical modules until after content paint.

findings.summary: Pages ship substantial JavaScript and CSS unused during initial rendering.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 123 KiB unused JavaScript and 64 KiB unused CSS on the article; HAR shows one ResourceLoader script transferring 259,136 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Split ResourceLoader modules by surface and interaction, conditionally load editing, preview and account features, and trim unused style modules from reader pages.

findings.summary: Some images, links and form controls lack accessible alternatives or labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt and label on home, and image-alt, label and link-name on the article; the image probe counted four images without alt and the DOM probe found an unlabeled secondary search input.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or explicit empty alt for decorative images, associate every search field with a label or accessible name, and name image-only links.

findings.summary: Inline links rely on color alone for identification.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-in-text-block on the home page even though its numeric color-contrast audit passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a non-color affordance such as an underline for inline links, with clear hover and focus states.

findings.summary: Production JavaScript lacks usable source maps and triggers DevTools inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed valid-source-maps and inspector-issues on both home and article templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish correct production source maps where policy permits and resolve the specific Chrome Issues entries in a development capture.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-description on home and article, and the article DOM probe returned description: null.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate concise, page-specific descriptions from the lead summary while preserving editorial controls and escaping.

findings.summary: The CSP permits unsafe script execution modes and one session-named cookie is not Secure.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found script-src unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; the cookies primitive found jawikimwuser-sessionId without Secure or HttpOnly and reported SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Move toward nonce/hash-based CSP without unsafe-eval, and set Secure, HttpOnly where script access is unnecessary, and the narrowest viable SameSite value on session cookies.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced policy headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy, or HTTP Referrer-Policy; only in-document referrer metadata was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and an HTTP Referrer-Policy appropriate to cross-wiki navigation.

findings.summary: Most below-fold home images are fetched eagerly.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 25 below-fold images without loading="lazy" among 32 images; HAR recorded 38 image requests and 215,393 transferred image bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails while keeping the actual LCP image eager and fetch-prioritized; continue serving responsive thumbnail sizes.

taskList.title: Replace the fixed 1120px mobile viewport with a reflowing responsive layout
Improve long-article LCP and conditionally load reader-page code
Repair accessible names, labels, image alternatives and inline-link affordances
Harden CSP, cookies and browser policy headers
Honor the operating-system color scheme by default
Resolve source-map and DevTools inspector hygiene
Progressively enhance article navigation with cross-document View Transitions
